Factions, reputation and service unlocks

Simple authored factions give recorded standing gains/losses, thresholds and service/quest/price unlocks. Reputation changes come from validated events and should not make required progression permanently impossible.

Scope and player interaction

Simple authored factions give recorded standing gains/losses, thresholds and service/quest/price unlocks. Reputation changes come from validated events and should not make required progression permanently impossible.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase20committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Unknown → Neutral → Recognized → Trusted → Honored → Restricted

WBP_Stats observes results from URPGReputationComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_Faction_RiverCompact. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
FactionId: stable faction.* ID
Standing: bounded integer, proposed -3000..12000
Thresholds: strictly increasing named tiers
ReputationEventId/source entitlement: deduplicated durable change
ServiceModifiers: authored price/unlock/quest conditions, versioned
RecoveryRoute: alternate quests/services for required progression

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGReputationComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_StatsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
ApplyReputationEvent(CommandId, VerifiedSource, FactionId, Delta) -> Updated|Duplicate|InvalidSource
GetStandingView(FactionId) -> TierAndProgress
ValidateFactionService(CharacterId, ServiceId) -> Allowed|StandingRequired

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Quest/world-event/combat policy emits a verified reputation entitlement with faction and bounded delta.
  2. Backend deduplicates, clamps within allowed range, persists event/standing and returns new revision.
  3. Zone updates owner reputation view and re-evaluates relevant NPC/dialogue/trainer/vendor conditions.
  4. Merchant quote includes the current reputation modifier/version; a change invalidates stale quotes under the chosen quote policy.
  5. UI explains standing thresholds and affected unlocks without recomputing authoritative prices.
  6. Content validation ensures the main quest route has recovery/alternate access when optional faction choices reduce standing.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author RiverCompact, CairnWardens, AshenSurvey and TideboundLeague faction definitions with original text and bounded tiers.
  2. Create DA_Faction_RiverCompact and one +100 RoadSupplies reward event as a fixture.
  3. Add URPGReputationComponent to PlayerState and WBP_Stats reputation view.
  4. Reopen NPC/dialogue/quest/vendor/trainer definitions for explicit standing requirements and modifier IDs.
  5. Add negative-standing and threshold-crossing fixtures, including reconnect and stale merchant quote.

Reopen Phase20 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_Mara / ReputationFixture_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Replay reputation reward -> unchanged standing.
Client submits arbitrary delta -> InvalidSource.
Threshold table unsorted -> validation fails.
Required story service inaccessible after optional choice -> content gate fails until alternate route exists.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed thresholds Neutral=0, Recognized=1000, Trusted=3000, Honored=6000; all tuning. No full faction war/geopolitical simulator.

Audit source entitlement and before/after tier. Use text tier names and numeric progress; do not rely only on faction colors.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
